name: RA_CUSTOMER_BANKS_INT_ALL
description: This is part of customer import program. This is the open interface table for the Customer bank accounts while importing customers

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system of customer data. Use the Manage Source Systems task to identify valid values. Examples: Siebel, Dun and Bradstreet.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the Customer Import job that created the row.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is used by the import wizard to relate a record in the interface table to the file row.
